AGO esports (formerly known as AGO Esports, AGO Gaming, and AGO) is a Polish professional esports organization founded in 2016.

  • July 4th - AGO Gaming enter Counter-Strike: Global Offensive by signing Furlan, Snatchie, phr, TOAO, and GruBy. [1]

  • August 2nd - snatchie is acquired by Virtus.pro. [4]
  • August 6th - AGO Esports acquire SZPERO from Team Kinguin. [5]

  • December 18th - AGO Esports acquire kap3r from Team Kinguin on permanent basis. [7]

  • August 26th - AGO remove hades and SAYN from the trial pool as they add F1KU and jedqr. [12]
  • September 2nd - AGO part ways with jedqr. [13]

  • February 11th - AGO bench mhL. [15]
  • February 17th - AGO reinstate mhL to the starting lineup. [16]
  • March 9th - AGO acquire oskarish from Illuminar Gaming. [17]
  • April 24th - AGO transfer Sidney and leman to AGO NEST. [18]

  • October 1st - snatchie and rallen leave AGO following the expiration of their contracts. [29][30]

  • February 1st - AGO esports part ways with leman, phr, snatchie, and sh3nanigan. [45]
